== Reflections Gold matching-pilot correction ==
The Reflections Gold Boba Fett printing has no Pilot icon and intentionally blank game text. Removed its unconditional matching-pilot relationship with Slave I from both pages. Slave I requires a bounty hunter pilot; GEMP's matching-pair check also requires a valid pilot. Boba Fett's Blaster Rifle remains a matching weapon: its text explicitly permits Boba Fett. Sources: [[:File:RG-T-Boba-Fett.png]], [[Slave I]], [[Boba Fett's Blaster Rifle]] and [[Reflections Gold#Three card types]].
